svg.title: SpendSnap — State Diagram: Auth Gate & Navigation

g.text: SpendSnap — State Diagram: Auth Gate & Navigation
shows a spinner while the persisted
Every data-driven screen opens its Firestore
subscription in useEffect and returns the
unsubscribe handle, so listeners are torn
down on unmount — no leaks across tabs.
A Quick Action fired before the navigator is
ready is queued in a ref and replayed on
Add Expense resolves each group doc
ticks the active groups to share it with
one collapsible card per active group
invite code · members · member pie chart
